# DermaRoute
> B2B wound care procurement portal: benefit verification, product ordering, BAA e-signing, and a RAG-powered CMS policy assistant.

## What it does
DermaRoute streamlines wound care procurement for healthcare providers. It routes benefit verification requests, manages product ordering across tissue biologics, ocular products, and medical devices, and includes an AI-powered CMS policy assistant built on RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation).

## Key features
- Benefit verification request submission and tracking
- Multi-track product ordering (wound care, ocular, medical devices)
- BAA (Business Associate Agreement) e-signing
- Healing tracker with wound measurement logging
- RAG-powered CMS policy assistant (Gemini + pgvector)
- Role-based access: provider, clinic staff, admin

## Tech stack
Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, Supabase/Postgres, Drizzle ORM, pgvector, Gemini RAG, Tailwind CSS, Vercel.

## Links
- Live demo: https://derma-route.vercel.app/demo
